title: A four-level executable validation protocol for evaluating LLM-generated topology specifications of physics-based HVAC digital twins
abstract: arXiv:2611.25471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-based digital twins of air conditioning, a principal energy consumer in manufacturing and buildings, can be generated automatically from a declarative specification of its equipment, connections, and sizing. Large language models (LLMs) now write such specifications from plain-language descriptions. Evaluations of these specifications stop at parse success, completed runs, or textual similarity, and cannot reject a model that converges in simulation but is physically wrong. In this study, a four-level protocol is proposed that tests whether an LLM-written specification not only executes but also yields a physically valid digital twin. Each specification is executed through static validity, model build, simulation convergence, and behavioral equivalence with a hidden reference model within bands calibrated by $\pm$20% sizing perturbations. translated_title: 一种用于评估大语言模型生成的物理式暖通空调（HVAC）数字孪生拓扑规范的四层可执行验证协议
translated_abstract: 空调是制造业与建筑物中的主要能源消耗设备，其基于物理的数字孪生可以根据对设备、连接关系和尺寸参数的声明式规范自动生成。如今，大语言模型（LLM）能够根据自然语言描述撰写此类规范。然而，现有的规范评估方法仅停留在解析成功、运行完成或文本相似性层面，无法拒绝那些在仿真中收敛但物理上错误的模型。本研究提出了一种四层验证协议，用于检验LLM撰写的规范不仅能成功执行，还能产生物理上有效的数字孪生。每份规范需依次通过静态有效性检验、模型构建、仿真收敛，以及与隐藏参考模型的行为等价性验证（等价性带宽通过±20%的尺寸扰动进行校准）。该协议被应用于八个LLM和十四种HVAC拓扑结构，其中五种描述的是一个ex……（摘要内容被截断）
tldr: 本研究提出一个包含静态有效性、模型构建、仿真收敛和行为等价性四个层级的可执行验证协议，用于评估LLM生成的HVAC数字孪生规范是否物理有效，并在八个LLM和十四种HVAC拓扑上进行了验证。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a four-level executable validation protocol—covering static validity, model build, simulation convergence, and behavioral equivalence—to assess whether LLM-generated HVAC digital twin specifications are physically valid, and evaluates it across eight LLMs and fourteen HVAC topologies.
